title: A Match Warms Up an Ice Cube (Together Forever)
description:
A shivering ice cube meets a match that wants to help. Things melt, things get soaked, and the ending is not what either of them planned.
A silent 3D short about friendship and changing states of matter. Fiction made with AI-assisted tools; nothing here is real footage or a real event.
Follow Klunk Studio for more silent gags with a twist.

Original animation, music and sound effects.
